 "content": "def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    # Locate the long vertical 5-divider and replicate the adjacent pattern
    # on its right along the full extent of the divider.  The pattern may
    # contain multiple rows, so repeat its row-cycle vertically.
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(g[r][c] == 5 for r in range(h)) > 1]
    c = max(cols, key=lambda c: sum(g[r][c] == 5 for r in range(h)))
    rows5 = [r for r in range(h) if g[r][c] == 5]
    top, bottom = min(rows5), max(rows5)
    right = [j for j in range(c+1, w) if any(g[r][j] != 0 for r in range(h))]
    if right:
        j0, j1 = min(right), max(right)
        # Pattern rows are the adjacent nonzero block at the bottom.
        src_rows = [r for r in range(top, bottom+1) if any(g[r][j] != 0 for j in range(j0,j1+1))]
        if src_rows:
            # Preserve the source pattern and repeat its row-cycle upwards.
            pattern = [[g[r][j] for j in range(j0,j1+1)] for r in src_rows]
            for r in range(top, bottom+1):
                rowpat = pattern[(r-top) % len(pattern)]
                for k, v in enumerate(rowpat):
                    g[r][j0+k] = v
    # A horizontal 5-divider with a vertical adjacent color strip: repeat
    # that strip across the region to the right of the strip and above/below
    # the divider, as indicated by the bars.
    hor_rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v == 5 for v in g[r]) > 1]
    if hor_rows:
        r = min(hor_rows)
        cols5 = [j for j,v in enumerate(g[r]) if v == 5]
        left, right5 = min(cols5), max(cols5)
        # color seed is immediately below the left end of the horizontal bar
        seed_col = left
        seed = [g[i][seed_col] for i in range(r+1,h) if g[i][seed_col] != 0]
        if seed:
            # fill from below the bar, across its horizontal span
            for i in range(r+1, h):
                val = g[i][seed_col]
                if val:
                    for j in range(left+1, right5+1):
                        if g[i][j] == 0: g[i][j] = val
    return g
